newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKS LEAPS TO RECOVER LOST GROUND.
newsitem.headline: FOREKS LEAPS TO RECOVER LOST GROUND.

text.p: Forekspank's shares recovered lost ground Friday on news it won a court case against the St Petersburg tax police to unfreeze its correspondent accounts.
It rose to 238/241 kroons from 224 kroons by 0930 GMT.
"There was good news of the court decision in St Petersburg showing the risks for Forekspank are not big," one trader said.
"Forekspank was left behind by the negative news and it is now making up lost time," another dealer said.
Another bank affected by the account freeze was Tallinna Pank .
It was also higher at 68.25/68.75 kroons from 65 kroons after announcing that its account in St Peterburg had been unfrozen and was operating normally.
